description: Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development - Order to appoint Eng. W. B. Palugaswewa and five others for the Advisory Committee under Urban Development Act
categorisation: This gazette exclusively lists specific individuals (named persons) being appointed to an advisory committee with their basic titles only (e.g., "Chairman," "Member," "Additional Secretary," "Director General"). It does not contain any detailed descriptions of their portfolio responsibilities or subject matter duties, which would be required for a Hybrid (Type 3) classification. The content is purely about government personnel changes.
